notes: lensacademy.org, ai-2040.com, web.archive.org and mirror/proxy services are all blocked by this environment's egress proxy, so the site could not be fetched directly. However, Lens Academy publishes its full curriculum content in public GitHub repos that directly serve the website (per the repo README: lens-edu-production is 'used directly by the production website (lensacademy.org)'; lens-edu-staging serves staging.lensacademy.org). Both repos were cloned and parsed on 2026-08-21, so this listing is the exact live curriculum source. Lens Academy is a multi-course platform, so 'sessions' here is a flat list spanning 10 courses; each session object carries a 'course' field, a per-course 'session_in_course' number, and 'n' is global. Sessions correspond to Lens Academy's units/modules (each normally ends in a 90-minute cohort meeting; meeting titles are used as session titles where defined). 'core'=false marks items Lens Academy labels optional (Dive Deeper / optional lenses / optional reading collections). Course-specific notes: (1) AI Risk Fundamentals (slug ai-risk-fundamentals, alias superintelligence-101) is the flagship intro course: core reading is the book 'If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies' (Yudkowsky & Soares, 2025) chapter-by-chapter (no URL - students use their own copy), plus the required film 'POV: What You Would See During an AI Takeover' replacing chapters 7-9, plus ~150 optional supplementary Q&A pages on ifanyonebuildsit.com. (2) Navigating Superintelligence (slug navigating-asi) is the default course at lensacademy.org/course. (3) 'Verifying International AI Agreements' (slug ai-verification) is the compute-verification course marketed at lensacademy.org/courses/compute-verification; it is a guided read of the 11-paper AI 2040 'Plan A' verification reading list (ai-2040.com/supplements/verification-plan/get-involved); its content currently lives in the staging repo. (4) 'AI Futurism' modules (4 weeks + extended readings, based on the reading list curated by Alexa Pan for Redwood Research's Astra Strategy Fellowship) exist fully-built in the production repo but no course file references them - treated as unlisted/upcoming; its Week 1-4 'optional readings' collections and the Extended Readings module are marked core=false. (5) AI Safety Atlas and AFFINE are co-branded partner courses; EA Introductory Program is the standard EA Handbook curriculum hosted on Lens; Facilitator Training Program is their navigator/facilitator pedagogy course (its named readings are listed without URLs where the source URL is embedded only in prose; durations in titles are Lens's own annotations). Excluded as non-curriculum: 'Demo' course, 'Iliad Intensive (Lens demo)' and 'Existential Risk Laboratory (Lens demo)' placeholder partner demos. Staging-only work-in-progress courses not yet published (not included above): 'XLab AI Control' (7 modules), 'Compute Verification: XLab Alpha' (import of UChicago XLab's curriculum), 'Thinking about Thinking' (5 modules), 'How to Talk to People About AI' (1 module). Year fields come from the 'published' metadata Lens stores per imported article; video years are omitted where Lens stores none. Authors are as recorded by Lens (occasionally a channel/site name).
